title: Deep Inner Space
description:
This file is focused entirely on bettering your mental state, from a non-erotic approach. I take you down in a very soothing manner. And don’t worry, I’m right there to keep you safe and calm through the entire experience. The induction portion is paced with a special attention placed on making the experience as gentle and comfortably paced as possible.

I will guide you to your inner space, where I will show you how wondrous it is to spend time there, relaxing and letting go of the rest of the world.

I will teach you just how useful this space is, and all of it’s many benefits. As you drift, you will get to enjoy a soothing feeling of leaving all of cares behind. And, after all is said and done, I will send you back out into the world with a wonderful feeling of peace and serenity.

I can’t wait to hear how much this helps you in experiencing and interacting with everything around you.
